data.one_liner: Creates, parses, formats, and handles LRC song lyrics strings.
data.what_it_does: A Dart-only package that parses LRC formatted string content into structured data models. It allows creating LRC lyrics from scratch, formatting objects back to strings, and streaming lyrics according to their timestamps.
use_when: You need to display time-synced song lyrics in a Flutter or Dart app
You need to parse or generate LRC lyrics files as strings
avoid_when: You need to read files directly from disk without manually loading them into a string first
strengths: Supports simple, extended, and enhanced LRC types
Provides extension methods for seamless string parsing and formatting
Includes built-in streaming capabilities for lyrics synchronization
weaknesses: Does not accept files directly; strings must be extracted manually first
